recommendation: Keep the fix. It completes the Applied issue without deleting ImplementationGuide.global; any future removal of the global element itself should be handled as a separate work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-41590 asked to address validator warnings from ImplementationGuide/example's global Patient profile. The Applied/Persuasive with Modification resolution was to change the example to example.org rather than leave real DAF and US Core profile references.
initial_application: Commit ddd2773b64b4d3ed0fa3fd98ca74ee0dfa2d86bd partially applied FHIR-41590 by changing only ImplementationGuide.dependsOn.uri to an example.org URL. The current source still retained the DAF canonical URL, DAF package id, DAF rendering URL, and three US Core Patient profile references, including the global profile.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ImplementationGuide as an active approved resource, and source/implementationguide/list-ImplementationGuide-examples.xml includes ImplementationGuide/example, so the XML source is in the current build scope. The linked Zulip thread shows the validator warning caused by the global US Core Patient profile, and FHIR-I minutes record a 10-0-0 decision to change the profile to example.org.
reconciliation: Updated source/implementationguide/implementationguide-example.xml so the example URL, package id, rendering URL, global Patient profile, definition resource profile, and manifest resource profile use example.org values. This preserves the global element as an example while avoiding a real unresolved US Core global profile assertion.
source_changes: source/implementationguide/implementationguide-example.xml: changed the example canonical URL, package id, rendering URL, and Patient profile references from DAF/US Core identifiers to example.org identifiers.
